record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, switch the existing two bidirectional Transformer blocks from pre-normalization to post-normalization (norm_first=False), retaining attention heads, 2× feed-forward width, GELU and residual connections. Normalizing each residual output may stabilize contextual representations with the incumbent's small normalized embeddings. Keep features, embeddings, history, masked-item loss and optimizer fixed; use the identical architecture in the predictor writer.
